title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction
When it comes to pregnancy nutrition, eating a balanced and varied diet is crucial for the health and well-being of both mother and baby. However, many pregnant women struggle to choose the right foods. In this article, we will explore some international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping you build a nutritious and balanced meal plan.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
Here are some international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to lower cholesterol and improve digestive health.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of baby's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in protein, iron, and fiber, supporting steadier energy when used within a clinician-guided overall meal pattern.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting the overall development of the baby.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, boosting the immune system and reducing the risk of illness.

## Building Balanced Plates
To create a balanced and nutritious meal plan, you can combine these international pantry staples in various ways. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: lentils with leafy greens and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: eggs with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
When eating during pregnancy, it's essential to consider food safety. Here are some tips:
- Eat a balanced and varied diet to ensure optimal health for both mother and baby.
- Avoid foods high in mercury, such as shark and swordfish.
- Avoid foods that may contain listeria, such as soft cheeses and deli meats.
- Stay hydrated and limit caffeine and sugary drinks.

## Conclusion
Eating a balanced and varied diet is crucial for the health and well-being of both mother and baby. With these international pantry staples, you can create a nutritious and balanced meal plan. Remember to consider food safety and consult with your healthcare provider to ensure optimal health for both you and your baby.
